hints: The skeleton is Dijkstra's: pick the closest unfinished vertex, mark it done, relax its neighbours. Only the relaxation changes.
key[v] holds the weight of the single cheapest edge connecting v to the tree so far - NOT the distance from the source. So the update is 'if (w[u][v] < key[v])', with no key[u] + ... in it.
Record parent[v] = u whenever you improve key[v]; those n-1 parent links are the tree.
source: DSA theory: Prim's algorithm; Week 5 Q1
title: Prim: grow the tree from a source
